package <empty> {
  class Annot(n: Int) extends scala.annotation.Annotation(), scala.annotation.
    StaticAnnotation {
    val n: Int
  }
  class EmptyAnnot() extends scala.annotation.Annotation(), scala.annotation.
    StaticAnnotation {}
  class Multi(first: Int, second: Int) extends scala.annotation.Annotation(),
    scala.annotation.StaticAnnotation {
    val first: Int
    val second: Int
  }
  final lazy module val SourceAnnotations: SourceAnnotations =
    new SourceAnnotations()
  final module class SourceAnnotations() extends Object() {
    this: SourceAnnotations.type =>
    def bare(value: Int): Int = value:(value : Int) @unchecked
    def empty(value: Int): Int = value:(value : Int) @EmptyAnnot
    def positional(value: Int): Int = value:(value : Int) @Annot(1)
    def named(value: Int): Int = value:(value : Int) @Annot(n = 1)
    def mixed(value: Int): Int = value:(value : Int) @Multi(1, second = 2)
    def mixedAfterNamed(value: Int): Int =
      value:(value : Int) @Multi(first = 1, 2)
  }
